user_direction: Stop previous training; one shared PINN for steady flow, following authors LDC task.
task: Geometry and Reynolds number to steady u,v,p; one set of weights across all 640 TRAIN cases. No time, prefix, case-ID or per-case fitting.
dataset: Pinned FlowBench harmonics LDC_NS_2D, 1000 cases at native 512x512; no new CFD. All large files stay on Perun.
split: 640 TRAIN / 160 VAL / 200 sealed TEST; authors standard random flowcase splitting, own seed. Not geometry-disjoint.
coordinate_system: Cell centres in [0,1]^2, corresponding physical cavity [0,2]^2; viscosity 1/Re in normalized steady NS, confirmed by TRAIN reference audit.
architecture: Own smooth geometry-conditioned coordinate PINN; CNN geometry encoder/global latent and C4 spatial features; MLP predicts streamfunction and pressure. Continuous velocity via autograd curl; native-grid curl uses the matching finite-difference stencil, explicitly tested.
conditioning: Native 512x512 fluid/SDF input is pooled to 64x64 inside each timed query. Geometry encoding is recomputed, no input-dependent cache. Pressure gauge uses predicted fluid mean; solid cells zero from known geometry.
optimization: Fresh seed, Adam, cosine to 5e-5, 400 exact full-TRAIN epochs, batch 4 cases: 64000 updates. 2048 sampled TRAIN fluid targets per case; 64 interior continuous PDE points per case; 64 outer-wall plus 64 obstacle BC points per case. Clip gradient norm to 1, never clip fields.
loss: TRAIN-only std-normalized supervised u/v/p MSE + 0.001 steady incompressible Navier-Stokes and continuity + 0.01 no-slip BC. Physics warmup 2000 updates and linear ramp 2000. NS includes convection, pressure gradient and viscosity, differentiated with autograd through velocity/streamfunction and geometry encoder.
bc: Top wall u=1,v=0; other outer walls and obstacle stationary. Exclude corner discontinuities in outer BC sampling. Obstacle surface approximated by native mask half-cell faces.
validation: All 160 VAL cases at update 0 and every 10 epochs/end; choose smallest mean per-case unnormalized all-cell u/v/p MSE. No optimizer gradient or normalization statistics from VAL. Also report relative L2, separate velocity/pressure error, near-obstacle error, and FD NS/divergence against reference numeric floor.
comparison: Same dataset task and split proportions as authors, own PINN architecture/seed; not exact reproduction of author architectures or numeric results. Mask/gauge conventions recorded. No imported FNO/template.
timing: Before training and after best selection: 30 warmups then 200 synchronized CUDA-event full-field queries on one TRAIN and one VAL input. Includes native pooling, encoder, MLP, interpolation, curl, gauge and mask; excludes host transfer/rendering and input-independent coordinate stencil setup. Report p50/p95/p99; require p99<=5ms on H200. Additional one-query per-VAL diagnostic is not a p99 estimate.
smoke: Separate fresh 8 TRAIN / 2 VAL subset, 3 optimizer updates with PDE active immediately. Must finish including native speed checks before fresh full-TRAIN model starts. Smoke is not an accuracy experiment.
outputs: Frozen sources/protocol, split reference, audited cache fingerprints, sampler hash and per-case counts, best/last and optimizer/RNG checkpoints, loss history, all VAL numeric metrics, repeated timing, real scheduler allocated resources.
next: After baseline quality audit, controlled LLM-vs-baseline configuration experiments with equal budget and multiple seeds; final TEST remains closed during development.
